mechanism: Rasagiline is a selective irreversible MAO-B inhibitor that can potentiate monoamine effects, and minocycline has mild MAOI properties and can increase serotonin; combined use may elevate serotonin syndrome risk.
action: Monitor for serotonin syndrome symptoms (agitation, tremor, hyperthermia, muscle rigidity); consider alternative antibiotic if possible; educate patient on warning signs.
